FIX ROUND 1 (B-RECUR-MOB, agent 114) — growth-project-mobile#334 @ 3fc925d432666eab17d5a51c3e88e3a68efcecb6

Tier T4. Pairs with backend #654. **Merge order: backend #654 deploys first** (backend #628 too, for End my plan).

- Renewing plans now sell as real subscriptions on every package surface (Day 1 sheet, Membership plans, share link; join links and paywall route into these): subscription-intent -> native TGP-themed PaymentSheet (payment, or setup for a trial) -> bounded plan polling -> success moment / calm still-confirming state. One-time -> payment-intent; $0 -> claim-free. No hosted Checkout and no webview in these flows (OR-113-1).
- Terms visible before paying; every backend code has its own copy and next action; one idempotency key per attempt, double tap guarded; secrets memory-only.
- Apple Pay / Google Pay off by config until a merchant ID / switch is set (OR-113-2), including the app.config.js plugin.
- Contract gaps for backend (mobile has fallbacks): error envelope drops `amount_cents` / `purchase_id`; share link from a coach the client is not attached to cannot be bought; cancel route is #628.

Required checks at 3fc925d4: Typecheck, lint, test pass (434 suites / 5999 tests); Analyze (javascript-typescript) pass; Analyze (actions) pass.
Fix-round table and evidence: PR body.

READY FOR AUDIT

AUDIT Claude Opus 5.5 — growth-project-mobile#334 @ 3fc925d432666eab17d5a51c3e88e3a68efcecb6 — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES

This is a T4 audit paired with backend #654 at `16cf4ca9`, where my verdict is REQUEST CHANGES ([5964353243](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/654#issuecomment-5964353243), addendum [5964371107](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/654#issuecomment-5964371107)). It is against FIX ROUND 1 ([5964380483](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/334#issuecomment-5964380483)). I focused on `src/lib/packagePayment.ts` (the contract, the error-code map and copy), `src/hooks/usePackagePurchase.ts` (attempt keys, sheet, polling) and `src/config/wallets.ts`, and checked every added string for copy rules. **A0 / B1 / C0.**

### What holds
- **Routing.** Renewing plans go to `subscription-intent`, one-time plans to `payment-intent`, and $0 plans to claim-free. The native PaymentSheet opens in payment or setup mode, and the mode is cross-checked against the `seti_` prefix (`packagePayment.ts:160-169`). No hosted Checkout or webview.
- **Attempt keys.** There is one key per (package, sale kind) attempt (`usePackagePurchase.ts:198-205`), and it is dropped once the card step finishes (`:492`, `:632`). Double taps are guarded. Secrets are kept in memory only, and none are logged or sent to Sentry.
- **Wallets.** Apple Pay is on only with a valid `merchant.` id on iOS. Google Pay is on only with an explicit switch on Android. Both are off by default (OR-113-2).
- **Copy.** Added strings contain no "we/us/our", no exclamation marks and no emojis. Each code has specific copy and a next action.
- **Checks.** Required checks pass at this head: Typecheck, lint, test (434 suites); Analyze (javascript-typescript); Analyze (actions).

### B-334-1: two codes from #654 FIX ROUND 1 fall to the generic error, and one strands the client on a dead key
#654 round 1 lists `PACKAGE_ALREADY_INCLUDED` and `SUBSCRIPTION_ATTEMPT_EXPIRED` as contract additions for this PR. Neither appears in `packagePayment.ts`, so both reach `default:` (`packagePayment.ts:731`). That path shows `PACKAGE_PAYMENT_COPY.unknown(ref)`, a generic support notice, and reports to Sentry.

1. **`SUBSCRIPTION_ATTEMPT_EXPIRED`.**
   - When it happens: #654 returns it for a same-key retry once the attempt has ended. That covers Stripe `incomplete_expired` after 23 h, which R1-8 marks `expired`, and an attempt retired as stale.
   - Why the client is stranded: on a sheet cancel or a notice, the hook keeps `attemptRef` (`usePackagePurchase.ts:484-490`). Every later tap on the same mounted screen therefore resends the dead key and gets the same generic error, until the screen remounts.
   - Fix: on this code, clear `attemptRef` and retry once with a fresh key (the backend contract says "start again with a NEW key"), or show specific copy and clear the key.
2. **`PACKAGE_ALREADY_INCLUDED`.**
   - When it happens: the client already holds the package through an invite, a free claim or a one-time purchase.
   - What they see: a generic error with a support reference, instead of "this plan is already included; open it".
   - Fix: map it next to `SUBSCRIPTION_ALREADY_ACTIVE` (`:676`) and offer an open-plan action.

Tests: one case per code through the hook, including the second tap after `SUBSCRIPTION_ATTEMPT_EXPIRED` with a new key.

### Pairing notes (no change needed here)
- Backend B-654-1 (trial start depends on Stripe setting the subscription default card) is backend-only. This PR's "still confirming" state is the right client behaviour either way.
- Backend C-654-4: the error extras never reach the wire. This PR's fallbacks (re-fetching the package price and `GET /v1/checkout/subscriptions`) are correct for that wire shape.
- Merge order: backend #654 (and #628 for End my plan) deploys before this PR, as stated.

**Re-audit:** a delta for B-334-1.

FIX ROUND 2 (B-RECUR-BE, agent 114) — growth-project-mobile#334 @ 0629d50601618af7a51d0f92c4bbf828001dba7a

Lane B-RECUR-MOB has finished, so this lane (the backend #654 builder) now owns #334. This round folds the Opus REQUEST CHANGES at 3fc925d4 ([5964410119](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/334#issuecomment-5964410119)) and the backend #654 changes that close CONTRACT GAP 1 and 2. Details are in the "Fix round 2" table in the PR body.

**B-334-1: `SUBSCRIPTION_ATTEMPT_EXPIRED`**
- The hook drops the dead key and starts once more with a fresh key, so the plan sells on the same tap.
- If the retry also expires, the client sees specific copy: "That checkout ended before it finished, so nothing was charged. Choose the plan again to start a new checkout."
- The next tap uses a new key. The dead key is never resent.

**B-334-1: `PACKAGE_ALREADY_INCLUDED`**
- Specific copy for each `included_by` value (invite, free claim, earlier purchase), plus Open your plan. No Sentry report and no support notice.

**Other #654 codes**
- `PACKAGE_COACH_NOT_CONNECTED` (share links): specific copy for each `reason`. The share-link surface sends `share_token` to subscription-intent only, and only in its valid 21-character form.
- `PACKAGE_IS_FREE` from subscription-intent: the app falls back to claim-free, as the one-time path already does.
- Every code backend #654 can return now has its own copy and next action. The full list is in the body.

**Contract**
- The app reads the error fields that #654's filter now sends. Its re-read fallbacks stay, so it works with either envelope.
- Merge order is unchanged: backend #654 (and #628 for End my plan) deploys first.

**Tests** (`ops/heavy.sh npx jest`)
- `PackageSelectionSheet.subscription`: 35/35. The 9 new cases fail on 3fc925d4 src (log `ops/brecurbe114/mob_failing_before.log`).
- `PackageCheckoutScreen.buyer`, `ClientPackagesScreen.purchase`, `paymentsApi`: 40/40.
- `tsc --noEmit` and eslint are clean.

**CI at 0629d506**
- Typecheck, lint, test: pass.
- Analyze (actions): pass.
- Analyze (javascript-typescript): pass.
- CodeQL: pass.

READY FOR AUDIT

AUDIT Claude Opus 5.5 — growth-project-mobile#334 @ 0629d50601618af7a51d0f92c4bbf828001dba7a — VERDICT: APPROVE

Lens: AUD-OPUS-114B, which owns the Opus verdicts in this session. This is a delta audit from the Opus RC at `3fc925d4` ([5964410119](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/334#issuecomment-5964410119)), against FIX ROUND 2.

**Counts:** A0 / B0 / C1.

### Verification
- **CI at this head:** Typecheck/lint/test, CodeQL, Analyze (js-ts) and Analyze (actions) all pass.
- **Local run** (`ops/heavy.sh`): `PackageSelectionSheet.subscription.test.tsx` and `ClientPackagesScreen.purchase.test.tsx` give 2 suites / 38 passed.
- **Tree hygiene:** there is no `node_modules` entry in the head tree.

### Prior findings
- **B-334-1 closed.**
  - **`SUBSCRIPTION_ATTEMPT_EXPIRED`:** the hook drops `attemptRef` and retries once with a fresh key on the same tap (`usePackagePurchase.ts:612-617`).
    - A second expiry gives specific copy that says nothing was charged, and clears the key again (`:620-623`). The dead key is never resent.
    - The retry is bounded to one, so it cannot loop.
  - **`PACKAGE_ALREADY_INCLUDED`:** there is copy for each `included_by` value plus Open your plan (`:630-640`), with no support notice and no Sentry report.
- **Other #654 codes:**
  - `PACKAGE_COACH_NOT_CONNECTED` gives copy for each `reason`.
  - `PACKAGE_IS_FREE` falls back to claim-free.
  - `share_token` is sent only in its valid form.
  - Each case is covered by the new tests.

### C (optional)
- **C-334-2 (operator, merge composition):** this PR and #322 both edit the past-due banner region of `ClientPackagesScreen.tsx`. Whichever merges second keeps #322's native Update card screen; the hosted-portal button must not come back.

### Release order (unchanged)
1. Backend #654 is fixed (B-654-1 is still RC from this lens) and deployed.
2. #628 is deployed for End my plan.
3. Then this PR.

No push, merge, dispatch or production action by this auditor.

AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-mobile#334 @ 0629d50601618af7a51d0f92c4bbf828001dba7a — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES

**Full T4; A/B/C 0/2/1.** This is this lens's first audit of the complete native one-time/recurring/trial flow, not just the last Opus delta. [PR scope](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/334)

### Prior findings first

**B-334-1 (Opus) closed:** expired attempts rotate the key once, a second expiration clears the dead key for the next tap, and included grants have specific reason-based copy and Open your plan; the actual-sheet tests cover these boundaries. [Prior finding](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/334#issuecomment-5964410119) [Fix round](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/334#issuecomment-5964783068) [Actual-sheet tests](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/0629d50601618af7a51d0f92c4bbf828001dba7a/src/components/__tests__/PackageSelectionSheet.subscription.test.tsx)

### B-334-3 — unknown native payment completion is reported as proven failure/no charge

`src/hooks/usePackagePurchase.ts:307–325,664–672` handles a thrown/unknown presentation result by returning a notice immediately; it does not read the known purchase's canonical state, while `src/lib/packagePayment.ts:852–869` uses the literal “The payment did not go through and nothing was charged.” [Presentation boundary](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/0629d50601618af7a51d0f92c4bbf828001dba7a/src/hooks/usePackagePurchase.ts#L307-L325) [Early return](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/0629d50601618af7a51d0f92c4bbf828001dba7a/src/hooks/usePackagePurchase.ts#L664-L672) [Unknown-result mapping](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/0629d50601618af7a51d0f92c4bbf828001dba7a/src/lib/packagePayment.ts#L852-L869)

A bridge/connection failure at this boundary is not proof that confirmation never committed, and the already available purchase id is discarded from the recovery path. [Purchase and continuation](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/0629d50601618af7a51d0f92c4bbf828001dba7a/src/hooks/usePackagePurchase.ts#L664-L690)

Independent mounted real-sheet/hook probe: the mocked native boundary loses its completion response, while the canonical GET fixture exposes an active committed plan; the app never reads it and displays the categorical no-charge message, failing the truthful-outcome assertion. This is synthetic uncertainty coverage, not a live Stripe/device claim. [Implementation under probe](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/0629d50601618af7a51d0f92c4bbf828001dba7a/src/hooks/usePackagePurchase.ts#L307-L325)

**Minimal fix:** distinguish definitely-not-started/card-declined from outcome unknown; for unknown presentation outcomes retain the purchase/attempt and read the plan (or one-time canonical attempt status), offer Check again, and only claim no charge after authoritative proof.

### B-334-4 — displayed free-trial/renewal terms are not reconciled with the actual intent before payment

`buySubscription:598–604,664–680` sends only the displayed recurring amount, then opens whatever mode the backend returned using the old package; returned trial/first-charge/one-time/currency/cadence fields are not reviewed before the sheet, and the trial length is adopted only after confirmation. [Request and payment boundary](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/0629d50601618af7a51d0f92c4bbf828001dba7a/src/hooks/usePackagePurchase.ts#L590-L680)

This is reachable with a valid paired-backend answer: #654 deliberately offers `trialDays=0` after an earlier trial with the same coach, while the mobile list still advertises the package's trial and its “Your card is saved today and not charged” terms. [Backend eligibility](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/795110b717b1554045d13bf596eeacb0c38f19c6/src/checkout/subscription-checkout.service.ts#L634-L677) [Trial terms](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/0629d50601618af7a51d0f92c4bbf828001dba7a/src/lib/planTerms.ts#L216-L237)

Independent real-sheet/hook probe starts from the visible seven-day free-trial CTA, returns a valid payment-mode intent with `trial_days=0` and `first_charge_cents=4900`, and observes immediate paid PaymentSheet initialization rather than current terms/confirmation; the pre-payment consent assertion fails. [Payment-mode handoff](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/0629d50601618af7a51d0f92c4bbf828001dba7a/src/hooks/usePackagePurchase.ts#L664-L680)

The same missing reconciliation covers combo drift: the request omits #654's `expected_one_time_cents`, and `resolvePriceChange:534–555` ignores the richer current one-time/cadence/currency fields and can resurrect a removed trial with `fresh.trialDays || pkg.trialDays`. [Mobile request DTO](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/0629d50601618af7a51d0f92c4bbf828001dba7a/src/lib/packagePayment.ts#L152-L165) [Price-change adaptation](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/0629d50601618af7a51d0f92c4bbf828001dba7a/src/hooks/usePackagePurchase.ts#L529-L559) [Backend price contract](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/654#issuecomment-5964340600)

**Minimal fix:** send the displayed one-time amount, validate/adopt the complete authoritative intent terms, and require explicit review when trial eligibility, first charge, currency, interval/count or combo amount differs before opening a chargeable sheet; preserve zero trial days as zero.

### C-334-2 — composition gate carried

#322's native card-update route must be retained when composing ClientPackagesScreen; this head still has the inherited hosted-portal handler, as already identified by Opus, so the final merged mobile tree needs a delta audit. [Prior optional finding](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/334#issuecomment-5964822138) [Current handler](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/0629d50601618af7a51d0f92c4bbf828001dba7a/src/screens/client/ClientPackagesScreen.tsx#L257-L274)

### Evidence / merge gates

All 22 own changed files reviewed (5,632-line full diff), including runtime, configuration and actual-sheet tests; the inherited main merge reconstructs exact automatic tree `49fbd0a59cdcc6b84a8addc68c133a0bb6aed9e3`. [Changed files](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/334/files)

Independent targeted run: **7 suites / 108 passed**; independent real-component probes: **2 failed**, 35 copied controls deliberately unselected, using only synthetic data and mocked external boundaries. [Candidate test scope](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/0629d50601618af7a51d0f92c4bbf828001dba7a/src/components/__tests__/PackageSelectionSheet.subscription.test.tsx)

All three exact-head required checks are green; no real-provider/device acceptance is claimed. [Typecheck/lint/test](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37090049342/job/111108268252) [CodeQL JS/TS](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37090049368/job/111108268702) [CodeQL actions](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37090049368/job/111108268517)

Backend #654/#628 must deploy before this mobile flow, and #654's inherited #627 round-8 head is now REQUEST CHANGES from this lens; fixes/retarget/composed-head checks and real device acceptance remain required. [#654 composition contract](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/654#issuecomment-5964942498) [#627 verdict](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/627#issuecomment-5964932906)

FIX ROUND 3 (B-RECUR-3, agent 115) — growth-project-mobile#334 @ 04104c2eb722e721101226e057a0701c84fe15ed

Start head 0629d50601618af7a51d0f92c4bbf828001dba7a (Sol REQUEST_CHANGES: B-334-3, B-334-4, C-334-2). Paired with backend#654 fix round 2 @ 02c48de710f9f69bfc985336eb14249663bbb638 (`mode: 'none'`, `checkout_state`, `SUBSCRIPTION_ATTEMPT_EXPIRED.reason`).

Commits: 37271f9 (merge mobile main 4f1d74d), d8360e0 (tests only), b82a821 (fix), 04104c2 (merge mobile main 47124a4d, #326; clean, no overlap with the purchase files).

Failing-before: test-only commit d8360e0 (src = 0629d506 + main) on `ci/B-RECUR-3-334-before`, one-job CI lane run https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37142521981 — red: 2 suites, 18 failed / 35 passed (the decline control and all earlier cases pass). After: this PR's CI at 04104c2e.

| Finding | Change | Commit | Test (red in run 37142521981, green at 04104c2e) |
|---|---|---|---|
| B-334-3 a sheet that threw / timed out / lost the connection / failed without card detail was reported as "nothing was charged" without reading the purchase | `runSheet` returns `uncertain` for those results (`isUncertainSheetResult`; a decline, auth failure or init failure stays definite). Subscription: the purchase and key are kept and `settleUncertain` reads `GET /subscriptions/:id`: entitled -> success; `payment_failed` -> failed-charge copy; `ended` -> checkout-ended copy; `paid`/`processing`/`card_saved` -> keep confirming (then the calm slow state); `awaiting_payment`/`awaiting_card` -> proven no-charge copy, and the next tap replays the same key; anything else (incl. `unknown`, a failed read) -> outcome-unknown copy (no charge claim), reference, Email support, **Check again**. One-time: reads the client's purchases for an entitled row of this package -> success, else outcome unknown + Check again, key kept | b82a821 | `PackageSelectionSheet.recur3.test.tsx` "(failed before) the native call throws but the plan is paid -> success, never the no-charge copy"; "(failed before) a failure without card detail while Stripe shows no payment -> proven no charge; the retry replays the same key"; "(failed before) a timeout while Stripe cannot tell -> outcome unknown (no no-charge claim), reference, Check again finds the plan"; "(failed before) a dropped connection while the payment is processing keeps confirming, then succeeds"; "(failed before) the plan read itself fails -> outcome unknown"; "(failed before) a trial whose card sheet threw while Stripe shows no saved card ..."; "(failed before) one-time: the native call throws but the purchase is paid -> success"; "(failed before) one-time: unknown and no paid purchase yet -> outcome unknown with Check again, which finds the purchase"; control "a card decline is a definite answer (no plan read)" |

| B-334-4 the intent's terms were never reconciled with what the client saw before a chargeable sheet | `reconcileIntentTerms` (planTerms.ts) compares renewal price, one-time part, currency, interval, interval count and trial days (zero stays zero) with the package shown; any difference -> terms review (`price-changed` block with the review copy, the adopted terms and the planTerms CTA), no sheet; confirm replays the SAME key. A first charge that does not follow from the answered terms -> support notice, no sheet (never a review loop) | b82a821 | "(failed before) shown a 7-day trial, the backend answers no trial (already used) -> review, no sheet; confirm replays the same key and pays"; "(failed before) a combo whose one-time part moved -> review, no sheet"; "(failed before) a cadence change (monthly -> every 3 months) -> review, no sheet" |

(body keys) |
| B-334-4 `resolvePriceChange` ignored one-time / currency / cadence and resurrected a removed trial (`fresh.trialDays \|\| pkg.trialDays`) | adopts `one_time_cents`, `currency`, `interval`, `interval_count` from the 409 body; the package re-read keeps `trialDays` as read (0 stays 0); review copy when more than the price moved | b82a821 | "(failed before) PACKAGE_PRICE_CHANGED read from the package never resurrects a removed trial"; "(failed before) PACKAGE_PRICE_CHANGED adopts the one-time part and cadence from the body" |

Updated: `PackageSelectionSheet.subscription.test.tsx` "PACKAGE_PRICE_CHANGED (price in the body) ..." — the confirmed attempt now answers the confirmed price (the reconciliation would otherwise correctly ask again).

Checklist: (a) Sentry gets cause / step / status / codes / short reference only (`reportPackagePaymentFailure`); the new test asserts no secret or key reaches it; (b) every await followed by a state write re-checks mount and attempt identity; (c) unmount race covered (row above); (d) new copy has no first person, no exclamation marks, no generic error, and never claims "nothing was charged" without Stripe's answer; (e) one failing-before test per finding. AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-mobile#334 @ 78ba9bc9a172f79fec5e7f8c3b0166acbf41dfe1 — VERDICT: APPROVE

Independent **T4 follow-up** from this lens's REQUEST CHANGES at `0629d50601618af7a51d0f92c4bbf828001dba7a`; **A/B/C: 0/0/2**. Original B-334-3/4 counterexamples are closed; this does not approve backend #654/#628, final #322 composition, or native provider/device acceptance. ([Prior Sol verdict](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/334#issuecomment-5965000602))

### Prior findings first

- **B-334-3 closed:** thrown/timeout/connection/unknown card completion retains the purchase/key and performs bounded canonical reads. It distinguishes entitled, processing, proven awaiting-payment/card, and unknown outcomes; unknown gets correlation/support plus a working Check again rather than a categorical no-charge claim. One-time uncertainty checks paid/entitled package purchases. The real hook/sheet tests cover original false failure, unreadable result, processing, retry, one-time recovery and the initial uncertainty-read unmount boundary. ([Actual recovery](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/78ba9bc9a172f79fec5e7f8c3b0166acbf41dfe1/src/hooks/usePackagePurchase.ts#L529-L672), [real-sheet regressions](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/78ba9bc9a172f79fec5e7f8c3b0166acbf41dfe1/src/components/__tests__/PackageSelectionSheet.recur3.test.tsx#L202-L366))
- **B-334-4 closed:** expected one-time cents are sent; authoritative price/one-time/currency/cadence/trial terms are reconciled before a chargeable sheet, changed terms require review with the adopted terms, and confirm retains the same attempt identity. Explicit zero trial days stay zero; price-change re-read no longer resurrects a removed trial, and a contradictory first charge stops rather than looping or opening the sheet. ([Before-payment comparison](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/78ba9bc9a172f79fec5e7f8c3b0166acbf41dfe1/src/hooks/usePackagePurchase.ts#L928-L976), [reconciliation](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/78ba9bc9a172f79fec5e7f8c3b0166acbf41dfe1/src/lib/planTerms.ts#L323-L385), [actual-sheet terms cases](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/78ba9bc9a172f79fec5e7f8c3b0166acbf41dfe1/src/components/__tests__/PackageSelectionSheet.recur3.test.tsx#L367-L476))
- Earlier **Opus B-334-1 remains closed**; new `mode:none` confirms without a native sheet or claiming the user's card was accepted, and expired changed terms have specific copy. ([Earlier closure and fix round](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/334#issuecomment-5964783068), [current no-sheet behavior](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/78ba9bc9a172f79fec5e7f8c3b0166acbf41dfe1/src/hooks/usePackagePurchase.ts#L957-L972))
